claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the text 'PSR-350' on the control panel.
The photos cannot show whether it powers on, keys sound, the LCD works, or the speakers work.

risks.risk: The keyboard does not power on
risks.proof: Video of the unit powering on with indicator lights or screen activating

risks.risk: Some or all keys produce no sound
risks.proof: Video pressing every key and hearing sound from each

risks.risk: The LCD screen does not function
risks.proof: Video of the screen displaying menus or settings

risks.risk: The speakers produce no sound or distorted sound
risks.proof: Audio or video of sound output through the speakers

risks.risk: Power adapter or cables are missing
risks.proof: Photo of the power adapter and cables included with the unit
Photo of any stand or bench included

risks.risk: Age and repair history are unknown, and wear may be extensive
risks.proof: Photos of repair receipts or close-up images of wear and damage

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on and all keys producing sound
Video of the LCD screen working and audio from the speakers
Photo of the power adapter, cables, stand, and bench if included
Close-up photo of the model label to confirm the exact model
response.reason: The witness identifies an electronic keyboard with visible PSR-350 text, contradicting the seller's PSR 550 claim; functionality and accessories are unproven, so it is priced at worst case pending proof.
